newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita says won't pay much for Haka deal.
newsitem.headline: Merita says won't pay much for Haka deal.

text.p: Finnish banking group Merita Oy is not prepared to pay much for a settlement with the City of Jeffersonville in the U.S. and Haka Inc in cases against it brought to a United States court, a Merita spokesman said on Tuesday.

"We are of course willing and prepared to settle things but since we do not find ourselves liable for compensation, we are not prepared to sacrifice any significant amounts of money," the spokesman said.
The spokesman declined to comment on a report in daily Kauppalehti that Merita would be willing to settle, which it said could at worst cost 650 million markka in compensation.
Merita said on January 7 that Jeffersonville's case against it -- related to the bankruptcy of Finnish construction group Haka Oy -- was groundless and could not succeed.
Haka Inc is the former U.S. subsidiary of bankrupt Haka Oy.
